newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's eight-month ethylene output up 4.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's eight-month ethylene output up 4.6 pct.

text.p: South Korea's ethylene output rose 4.6 percent to 2.58 million tonnes in the first eight months of this year compared to the same 1995 period, the Korea Petrochemical Industry Association said on Friday.

According to figures provided by the association, domestic ethylene sales rose 4.1 percent to 2.38 million tonnes in the first eight months from a year before, but exports surged 27.8 percent to 277,931 tonnes.

South Korea's synthetic resins output rose 7.2 percent to 4.4 million tonnes in the first eight months against the same year-ago period. Local sales were 2.43 million tonnes, up 5.3 percent. Exports rose 17.7 percent to 1.96 million, it said.
